alternatives.option: Stamp sqlite unconditionally (proposal rule 3 as written)
alternatives.reason_rejected: creates an in-team empty-database edge when the project creator runs old Node

context: Built v2.0.0-beta.1 scope (V1-V5) on branch v2.0-beta: engines 22.13 + CI 22/24 + prerelease dist-tag routing, auto backend resolution with legacy nudge, SUPPORTED_CONFIG_VERSION=2 with migrate stamps, init stamping, opt-in auto-migrate, upgrade docs. Full gates green (1063 tests, SOAK_SCALE=5).
rationale: Unconditional sqlite stamping on an old-Node creator's machine produces a config claiming sqlite while the server runs the files fallback and accumulates legacy state — a new-Node teammate would then boot an empty database next to real legacy files, exactly the silent-amnesia scenario the resolution rule exists to prevent, but inside a team. Stamping what will actually run keeps config.yml honest; files-stamped projects keep version 1 so 1.x teammates still work.
summary: DEVIATION from proposal: fresh init stamps backend by sqliteAvailable() (sqlite/version-2 when available, files/version-1 otherwise) instead of stamping sqlite unconditionally
